text_description: Full-length runway look built around a dramatic black, fur-like pile outer layer with an oversized cocoon silhouette, rounded shoulders, and voluminous long sleeves. The jacket/short coat has a high black neckline and a plush, bulky body that falls to the upper thigh, with bold cream-white furry contrast bands tracing the front edges from shoulder to hem, running along the outer sleeve/side areas, and appearing at the cuffs, creating a strong graphic black-and-ivory outline. The wearer’s hands are tucked into the side pockets, emphasizing the coat’s rounded volume and soft structure. Beneath it, a black narrow column skirt is visible from mid-thigh to lower calf, heavily textured with dense ruffled, shredded, or rosette-like surface appliqué and intermittent more open, lace-like areas that give the lower half a dimensional, tactile look. The outfit is styled in an almost entirely black palette interrupted by the ivory fur trim and pale shoe straps. Footwear consists of open-toe high-heeled sandals with light cream crisscross straps wrapping over the foot and around the ankle, worn over dark sheer hosiery or darkened legs. No bag or jewelry is visible; the styling is moody, plush, and high-contrast, combining oversized soft outerwear with an elongated, textured black skirt and delicate strappy heels.
key_elements: cream-white furry contrast bands along front and sleeves
black textured column skirt with ruffled/rosette surface
open-toe high-heeled sandals with pale crisscross straps
dark sheer hosiery or darkened legs
uncertainty_notes: Exact fur or shearling material cannot be identified from the image.
The lower black piece appears to be a skirt, but its waistband and attachment are hidden by the coat.
Hosiery is suggested by the dark leg appearance but not fully clear.
